declarations.notes: Finite q-Pochhammer product, valid for complex a, q, and every nonnegative n.
The reciprocal form records q ≠ 1 explicitly; q-factorial and q-Pochhammer are complex-valued.
HasProd states convergence for the source domain ‖q‖ < 1; no q > 1 claim is made.

Uses the source real-base domain 0 < q < 1 and complex z, with principal Complex.cpow; qGamma is a totalized quotient at a zero denominator, with qGammaPoleFree naming the meromorphic finite-value domain.
Real q in 0 < q < 1, matching the q-Gamma definition in this module.
Complex-valued q-factorial and q-Gamma with real q in the source range.
Complex argument recurrence with real 0 < q < 1 and principal Complex.cpow; both q-Gamma denominator products are required nonzero via qGammaPoleFree, excluding z = 0 and all totalized poles.
Real-axis qGammaReal specialization; includes both 0 < x < 1 and x > 2 cases. qGammaReal_coe records the pole-free bridge to complex q-Gamma.
Real-axis qGammaReal specialization on 1 < x < 2. qGammaReal_coe records the pole-free bridge to complex q-Gamma.
Real q approaching 1 from below and complex z, represented with nhdsWithin; qGamma and Complex.Gamma are totalized at exceptional poles, so the meromorphic source reading is pole-free.
Complex a, b with real q in 0 < q < 1; this is a totalized quotient identity, with the meromorphic q-Beta reading restricted to nonzero displayed q-Gamma denominators.
Jackson q-integral specialization with real q, Re(a) > 0, and Re(b) > 0; principal Complex.cpow is evaluated at positive sampled points.
Minimal denominator and pole-free-domain vocabulary needed to state the source recurrence without Lean's totalized pole values.
Domain-guarded bridge identifying the real-part projection qGammaReal with complex qGamma on the real axis away from q-Pochhammer poles.
Source prose claim that ln Gamma_q(x) is convex for x > 0, stated on the real-axis qGammaReal specialization.
Source prose claim giving the q-Bohr--Mollerup uniqueness characterization for the positive normalized log-convex q-recurrence.

known_gaps: Proof bodies remain by sorry during the statement-coverage phase.
The source gives no infinite-product or q-Gamma/q-Beta convergence assertion for q > 1; this module makes no such extension.
The source's q-digamma notation and generalized ln Gamma_q asymptotic expansions are documented but not formalized here.
